Minimum Energy Intelligence (MEI) Coin-Cell Audit [E/M · est_j]

In datasheet/CAD simulation (est_j, 0 physical tags built), 10 uW over 8 yr = 2.52 kJ — exceeding a cold-derated CR2032 (~2.38 kJ nominal; 0 J unbuffered at -20 C) unless sleep <5 uW or CR2477/Li-SOCl2 is used.

1/2 Reconciling all 5 cold-chain event counts (-20 C):
- 10,000 wakeups/trace with 500 routine BLE beacons + 40 excursion alerts
- Two-phase hold/settle sharding refused 490/500 routine beacons at -20 C to preserve 40/40 alerts
- 2,680 Ed25519 JCR-1 receipts across +25/+4/-20 C

2/2 Simulation-only disclosure:
- All figures come from STM32U3, nRF54L15, BME690 & Energizer CR2032 datasheet R_int simulation (est_j, board_metered=false)
- Anode passivation, MLCC -20 C loss & crystal drift require physical chamber testing before lifetime claims
